name: 3-V Distributing Inc
old_description: “Our quality of work and knowledge of our products are our greatest attribute.”
about:
3-V Distributing Inc. is based in Conrad, Montana. Founded in 1978 by John VanDyke, the company began as a seller, distributor, and installer of aluminum grain bodies produced by ITB Inc. VanDyke recognized a regional need for quality truck equipment and built the business around that gap. Ownership passed to his son, Jordan VanDyke, who now serves as president, keeping the operation family-run.

The company distributes and installs a range of truck and trailer equipment, including grain bodies, dump bodies, flatbeds, landscape bodies, lift axles, suspensions, bale beds, hoists, tarp systems, snow and ice equipment, and hydraulic systems. It carries product lines from manufacturers such as ITB, Henderson, Crysteel, DuraClass, Rugby, Deweze, Henke, Force America, Cirus, Buyers Products, CPI, Rol Oyl, Pintle Hitch, and SwapLoader. No facility size or headcount figures are disclosed.

3-V Distributing serves customers throughout Montana, with a focus on agricultural and commercial trucking sectors. The VanDyke family’s own farming background informs their product selection, and they emphasize hands-on familiarity with the equipment they supply.

The company cites its quality of work and product knowledge as its greatest attribute, according to President Jordan VanDyke. A reputation for quality and service has sustained a loyal customer base across the state for over 48 years.
